integrity: The proof is analytic and supported by standalone exact finite-moment tests and finite simulations; none of these computations certifies an infinite-system theorem or exhaustive literature originality.
scientific_limitations: Independent one-dimensional Brownian particles, positive constant diffusion and shared Poisson event rate, Bernoulli-marked random subsets, and stationary law only; no fixed-cardinality subset, interacting gas, non-Poisson clock, or transient/extreme-value theorem.
title: A sharp collective-fluctuation crossover under Bernoulli-thinned common resetting
